Findings

▲High  (3)
  Service sshd listening on all interfaces, port 22
    NET-001 · network · risk 83 (high) · observed
    · 0.0.0.0:22
    impact: A socket bound to a wildcard address accepts connections from every network the host is attached to, not only from this machine.
    fix: Bind to a specific interface or to loopback unless remote reachability is intended.
  Secure Shell exposed on port 22
    NET-002 · network · risk 83 (high) · observed
    · 0.0.0.0:22
    impact: A remote-administration port bound to a wildcard address is reachable from every network the host touches.
    fix: Restrict the listener to loopback or a VPN interface, and require a jump host for administrative access.
  Credential material present
    SEC-002 · secret-material · risk 75 (high) · observed
    · /home/aisha/.aws/credentials
    impact: A credential stored in a file is readable by every process running as that user and by anything that later obtains them.
    fix: Move the credential to a secret store or an agent, and rotate the exposed value.

▲Low  (1)
  Account with no last-login record
    ACC-003 · accounts · risk 19 (low) · inferred
    · aisha
    impact: An interactive account with no observable last-login record may be dormant, which keeps an unnecessary authentication path alive.
    fix: Confirm the account is still required; disable or remove it otherwise.

  Login name disclosed in the environment
    IDN-002 · environment · risk 33 (low) · observed
    · aisha
    impact: The login name travels with many ordinary operations and appears in logs, prompts and process listings.
